snake-io.description:
Develop your skills, try to survive as much as you can and become the biggest snake. You start as a small snake, get bigger by eating other snakes who try to do the same. You have to attack wisely but defend skillfully. How long can you survive?

Attack fast with the mass-eject booster and get in front of other snakes to beat them when they hit you head on, no matter how small you are or how big they are. The best one wins.

Snake.io has no lag issues or performance problems caused by internet connection. Play wherever and whenever you like. 

The left or right handed joystick controller and mass eject button are fine tuned for higher precision maneuvers and for more fun. 

Game Features:
- Grow fast to dominate the board with smooth gameplay
- No lag due to connectivity issues
- High precision gameplay with joystick control
- Improved CPU and battery performance for all mobile devices
- Unique online live events and real-time leaderboards

How to play:
- Cut in front of other snakes quickly to make them explode when they hit you head on
- Once you get them to hit you, eat them as fast as you can to gain more mass
- Eject mass to boost your speed with one button
- Try to beat the highest score based on your length during a session
- Internet connection is not needed, play wherever, you are offline or online

Are you a snake or a worm?

Thanks to you, the original Snake.io is back with new regular updates. We are a small team who are all motivated with your comments, reviews and support. As you know the game is still in active development and we constantly try to make it more fun. Your reviews are important for us!

You can like Snake.io on Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/snakeiogame/

Please send us any feedback. We take them seriously.

snake-clash.description:
Welcome to Snake Clash! The ultimate battle for survival in the world of snakes is about to begin.

Start as a hungry little snake, eat, grow, and fight to evolve into the biggest and most powerful serpent. Engage in thrilling duels in a fierce arena and become the last one standing!

► Eat and Grow
Constantly move across the endless battlefield, seize opportunities, and devour smaller snakes to evolve. Quick decision-making, precise controls, and strategic movements will determine victory.

The more you eat, the bigger you get, which in turn increases your attack power and presence. Don't just grow—dominate your opponents and rise to the top of the true food chain.

► Skins & Customization
Battles aren't just about strength. Collect a variety of skins to express your unique personality and style. You can grow into a being with your own color and charm! From flashy designs to quirky themes, combine countless options to create a one-of-a-kind snake that's unique in the world.

► Multiplayer iO Mode
Growth isn't limited to playing alone. Compete with friends in real-time multiplayer or face off against players from around the world. Experience the thrill of a rapidly changing battlefield where the situation can flip in the blink of an eye.

The battle for the top snake in the arena is always full of tension and excitement. Challenge yourself to become a true champion in a game that keeps you immersed every moment!


► Global Ranking System
Your efforts are rewarded with more than just in-game items. Your achievements in the Tower of Challenges and Seasonal Events are immediately reflected in the global rankings.

- Compete with players worldwide to aim for the highest rank.
- Receive special rewards and honorable titles based on your ranking.
- Claim the glory of being #1 and make your name famous in the world of Snake Clash!

► Play Anytime, Anywhere
No Wi-Fi? No problem. This is the perfect entertainment to enjoy anytime, anywhere—on a plane, during your commute, or in places without an internet connection. It provides endless fun and immersion whether you have a short moment or a long stretch of time.

► Challenge Now!
Snake Clash can be called the next evolution of the snake genre, combining the intuitive fun of a classic snake game with innovative elements like boss battles, seasonal events, and a global ranking system. Download now, and jump into the world of eating, fighting, and conquering.

It's time for your snake to dominate the battlefield!

snake-97.description:
Play Snake like it is 1997. This is a remake of the original Snake, complete with dot-matrix display and monotone sounds.
Rewind time and get a dosis of nostalgia that is as addictive (and frustrating) as the original.

Play Snake '97 and be prepared to lose some productive hours. 

Simply launch the app, touch a button and start!

Snake '97 features:
- old school controls 
- dot-matrix display
- original monotone sounds (bleep bleep)
- 9 original and 3 extra difficulty levels
- Snake 1 and classic Snake 2 
- 7 classic game modes (5110, 3210, 8210, 8850 and 3310, 3410, 7110 with Snake 2)
- bonus creatures (Snake 2)
- go through the walls! (Snake 2)
- 5 original and 2 extra labyrinths (Snake 2)
- a high score that cannot be reset (just like the original)

The story behind this game is that my smartphone got damaged, requiring me to revert back to an old phone. Suddenly I knew the smartphone was missing something and the idea for a accurate Snake remake was born.

Snake '97 is an homage to the classic mobile phone game programmed in 1997.

By carefully analyzing the classic gameplay, timing and controls, this Snake '97 remake is one of the most accurate available.

If you have any questions, comments or suggestions, feel free to contact me.
Have Snake fun! 

Best regards from Amsterdam,
The developer,
Willem.

snake-escape-tap-away.description:
Unwind your mind with Snake Escape, a calm yet clever puzzle journey that turns simple mazes into beautifully designed escape games of logic and satisfaction.

Snake Escape is a fresh twist on animal escape puzzles, built for users who enjoy smart and satisfying challenges. Your goal is to guide snakes out of tangled grids — tapping in the right order, finding safe paths, and unlocking that perfect “aha!” moment when everything lines up. Each maze feels handcrafted, combining the charm of snake games and smooth snake slide mechanics with clever animal escape logic. Watch the snakes wiggle and slither as your plan unfolds — it’s calm, clever, and addictively rewarding.

HOW TO PLAY:
- Tap to Move: Choose a snake, tap, and watch it move step by step through the grid.
- Think Smart: Each snake moves in order — plan ahead or they’ll get stuck in a jam!
- Escape All: Find the perfect sequence to help every snake escape safely and master the maze logic in this fun snake slide challenge.

UNIQUE FEATURES:
- Unique puzzle concept combining the charm of snakes with tap-to-move mechanics, creating a fresh escape game experience full of logic and strategy.
- Hundreds of handcrafted levels with different maze layouts, obstacles, and difficulty curves to challenge every type of users.
- Smart boosters to help you escape tricky moments: reveal grid paths with Grid Vision, highlight the right snake with Hint, or gain extra seconds using Add Time.
- Polished design and animation, smooth snake movement, and relaxing sound effects that make every puzzle feel satisfying and alive as they wiggle and slither their way out of the maze jam.

Snake Escape isn’t just about freeing snakes — it’s about freeing your mind.
Each puzzle trains your logic, rewards smart thinking, and delivers that satisfying moment when everything finally clicks. If you enjoy clever escape games that balance calm and challenge, this is a snake games adventure you won’t want to miss. Step into the maze and see how far your logic can take you.

snake-io-netflix.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.

It's a snake-eat-snake world: Slither around the screen to collect energy, grow bigger and devour your competition in this fast-paced arcade game.

You'll start out as a small snake in each round. Eat energy pellets to expand your size, and surround or cut in front of other snakes to explode them into (edible) segments. But watch out — because they'll be trying to do the same to you. In this reptilian battle royale, how long can you stay in one piece?

Netflix members can put their reflexes to the test with this mobile version of the classic .io arcade game played by hundreds of millions. Fine-tuned touch controls give you the precision you need to outmaneuver every other sneaky serpent on the field of battle.

SLITHER, EAT, SURVIVE

• Dart in front of other snakes and watch them explode when they hit you head on — then eat them as fast as you can to bulk up.
• Use the boost button to increase your speed at crucial moments. But deploy it wisely, since you'll lose mass each time you boost.

GET BIG, SCORE BIGGER

• Your score increases with your size; stay alive to thrive and try to set a new personal record with each round.
• Leaderboards let you see how your survival skills stack up with friends and other players.

NEW WAYS TO PLAY

• Complete achievements and daily challenges to add fun and colorful snake skins to your collection.
• Themed live events give you opportunities to take on big, bad boss snakes and unlock exclusive skins.
• Play offline or online; no internet connection required.

- Created by Kooapps.
